name: Dayang Enterprise Holdings Bhd
overview: 2026年，Dayang通过全资子公司DESB Marine Services签订合同，以1.177亿令吉建造并购买一艘91米维护/工作船，扩大Marine Offshore Support Services板块的船队。其他公告主要为股息、股东大会及关联交易授权等常规事项，未见其他业务板块有扩张、缩减或退出。
overview_en: In 2026, Dayang, through its wholly-owned subsidiary DESB Marine Services, entered into a contract to construct and purchase a 91-metre maintenance/work vessel for RM117.7 million, expanding the fleet of its Marine Offshore Support Services segment. Other announcements were mainly routine matters such as dividends, general meetings and related party transaction mandates; no expansion, reduction or exit was observed in other business segments.

segments.name: 海事离岸支持服务
segments.note: 今年通过子公司订造一艘91米维护/工作船，扩大船队。
segments.note_en: This year, through its subsidiary, the company contracted to build a 91-metre maintenance/work vessel, expanding its fleet.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司DESB Marine Services与Shin Yang Shipyard签订买卖协议，以1.177亿令吉（不含销售与服务税）建造并购买一艘91米维护/工作船。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary DESB Marine Services entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Shin Yang Shipyard to construct and purchase a 91-metre maintenance/work vessel for RM117.7 million (excluding sales and service tax).
